summary: Practise AML scoring, alert investigations and sanctions handling across four financial channels. Review the course outline and learning outcomes.
lede: Financial crime operations training for digital banking, mobile money and fintech covers channel-based controls for identifying, assessing and escalating suspected illicit activity. It is for AML officers, transaction-monitoring and sanctions analysts, and compliance managers who need to make consistent decisions across financial channels. Learners practise customer-risk scoring, transaction-alert investigations and sanctions dispositions, then document outcomes and prepare management information for oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for financial-crime practitioners who review customers, payments, alerts or control evidence across banking and digital-finance channels.
modules: FATF Digital Lending and Agency Channels
Basel AML Governance and Control MI
prerequisites: Working familiarity with AML or KYC operations and customer or payment records is expected. No coding is required; spreadsheet use is helpful for the scoring and management-information exercises.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
